title: Detroit: Become Human
summary: Experimental RenoDX Vulkan HDR, ultrawide, and DLAA support for Detroit: Become Human.
notes: Vulkan base pinned to RenoDX PR #564 commit 92d6d79ec8103b1aaea44c0085c3a88db723e6d5.
Requires ReShade 6.8.0 Full Add-On and the game's native Vulkan renderer.
Adds NVIDIA NGX DLAA at native resolution with a separate HDR-safe sharpening control; rejected frames fall back to native TAA.
The local Vulkan layer, launcher, NGX binary, super-resolution experiments, and diagnostic capture hooks remain experimental development components.
Adds an automatic, reversible aspect-ratio override and isolated Scaleform UI compensation for displays wider than 16:9; 3440x1440 uses its exact 43:18 ratio.
RenoDX Preset Off disables HDR look changes but keeps ultrawide compatibility active; select Aspect Ratio: Vanilla 16:9 to disable the geometry override.
Ultrawide signatures and scaling were independently reimplemented from research published by Rose / PCGamingWiki; no trainer binary or Cheat Engine payload is included.
Fully restart the game after adding, replacing, or removing the addon; live addon unload/reload is not supported.
Auto HDR and NVIDIA RTX HDR must be disabled. Late chapters remain user-validation for this experimental RC.
